description: The Relativity MCP server is designed to give AI assistants access to Relativity aiR capabilities through Model Context Protocol, an open standard for connecting AI tools to external data and services through MCP clients. As a system administrator, you can use it to perform day-to-day tasks such as managing matters, configuring workspaces, granting access, and reviewing system usage.
